canonical_definition:
What it is. Papers describe PDDL as a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on planning tasks expressed in PDDL-style environments. In AgentSquare: Automatic LLM Agent Search in Modular Design Space, it appears within a broader evaluation set described as "covering diverse use cases in web, embodied, tool use and game scenarios."

What it is claimed to measure. Papers do not link PDDL to any constructs or behavioral indicators through explicit measurement relationships. The only stated target is evaluating LLM agents on planning tasks expressed in PDDL-style environments, rather than a named construct or behavioral indicator.

Space of uses. The available paper uses PDDL as a benchmark within an evaluation suite for LLM agents. No other measurement instruments are linked to it, so the evidence does not show a recurring pattern of using it alongside particular named benchmarks or as an auxiliary check.
